contracts: Only a prepared, matching namespace plan can be retired
Confirmed stopped daemon/Keeper plus opener and native launch locks precede closure
Workspace label/tokens, all existing bindings and exact pane inventory must match
One permission is committed before close; uncertainty is observed without resending
Retired workspace ID reuse is rejected; unrelated workspace/pane data preserved
Namespace absence creates no state; retired namespace cannot silently prepare again
limits: Public ccb kill orchestration and verified-session reopening of deliberately retired namespaces remain incomplete.
Before-send crashes/transport ambiguity can leave retirement pending; no speculative retry is introduced.
Namespace closure does not independently prove every detached provider descendant exited.
Tested against offline Herdr fixtures; no live Herdr controls were performed.
